As an aside: bots are becoming more sophisticated at a rapid rate. It's not unreasonable to believe that sometime in the near future anyone could pay to have a botnet flood Voat (or any other forum) with posts and comments which are nearly indistinguishable from those of real users. This could allow anyone, or any large entity (i.e. corporations), to be constantly pushing their message throughout the entire site with little investment on their end. As Voat gets larger, swaying the perceived opinions becomes more profitable. I don't believe this is an immediate problem, but it is something we should be planning for.
